seo_title: Cost of Living in Tivat 2026: Visa, Prices, Reviews | Relocost
seo_description: How much does it cost to live in Tivat per month, do Russians need a visa, work, rent and reviews from those who relocated. A realistic moving budget in the Relocost calculator.
intro_text: A town on the Bay of Kotor with the Porto Montenegro marina: yachts, mountains by the sea and a calm, premium resort feel. Russian citizens get 30 days visa-free; life here is seasonal and pricier than in neighbouring Budva.
pros: The Porto Montenegro marina and a yachting atmosphere
Mountains right by the sea, the beautiful Bay of Kotor
A Russian-speaking community and familiar services
cons: Life is seasonal; much of it shuts down in winter
A small town with a limited choice of services
Banks are cautious about opening accounts

visa_steps.title: Visa-free entry
visa_steps.description: Russian citizens get up to 30 days visa-free — all you need is a passport.

visa_steps.title: Registration
visa_steps.description: You must register (beli karton) within the first 24 hours — usually handled by the landlord or hotel.

visa_steps.title: Renting housing
visa_steps.description: Prices are higher in summer; a long-term lease is the basis for a residence permit.

visa_steps.title: Boravak (residence permit)
visa_steps.description: Through property, setting up a company (d.o.o.) or employment.

visa_steps.title: Bank account
visa_steps.description: Montenegrin banks don't open accounts for everyone or right away — you'll need an address and grounds.

faq.question: Do Russian citizens need a visa for Tivat?
faq.answer: No, up to 30 days visa-free. For a long stay you obtain a residence permit (boravak).

faq.question: How much does it cost to live in Tivat?
faq.answer: More expensive than Budva and Podgorica — it's a premium resort. The exact budget is in the calculator above.

faq.question: Which language is spoken in Tivat?
faq.answer: Montenegrin (close to Serbian); Russian and English are widely understood in tourism.

faq.question: Can I pay with a Russian card in Tivat?
faq.answer: No, Russian cards don't work. You'll need a foreign bank card or euros in cash.

faq.question: What is the climate like in Tivat?
faq.answer: Mediterranean: hot summers and mild rainy winters, in a sheltered bay.

faq.question: How is Tivat different from Budva?
faq.answer: Tivat is quieter and more upscale thanks to Porto Montenegro; Budva is noisier and more touristy.

reviews.text: Tivat means mountains, sea and yachts — very beautiful and peaceful. Pricier than Budva, and in winter it's quiet to the point of dozing off, but for living by the sea it's excellent.
We chose Tivat because of Porto Montenegro and the bay. In summer it's expensive and dressed up. The tricky part was the bank — the account didn't open straight away.
